predict.why: T-096 measured the 100401 table against no table on this card (+38% provisional, noisy machine); arm base-no-table is that no-table path, so the prediction is against the base-no-table arm's number, not the plain config's

stop: an arm whose server dies before ready twice: stop the spec and read the engine log
the heuristic arm's engine log has no 'STRATA_HIPBLASLT_HEURISTIC=1' line or every call says 'Lt heuristic fallback': the arm is inert (the base), do not report it as a result
any arm whose engine log says 'refusing to start' (it carries no STRICT, so this is a bug)
note: LEADS.md Part T lead T3 (spec 253, NOT MEASURED, coded on lead/T2-T4). Three ways the prompt GEMMs run on the 7900 XT, all the updated build with the pancake daily preset of spec 251's updated arm: base-no-table (STRATA_HIPBLASLT_TABLE=off: plain hipBLASEx, today's no-table path), heuristic (the same plus STRATA_HIPBLASLT_HEURISTIC=1: calls without a table go through hipblasLtMatmulAlgoGetHeuristic, top 1) and table (STRATA_HIPBLASLT_TUNING = the 100401 table, the library on the box today is ROCm 10.0 / hipBLASLt 1.4.x, key 100401; on ROCm 10.2.0 (key 100500) point this arm at a freshly tuned gfx1100-hipblaslt-100500.txt instead, see tools/pancake/box_chains/tune-hipblaslt-table.sh). heuristic-top4 asks for 4 candidates and takes the first that succeeds (STRATA_HIPBLASLT_HEURISTIC_COUNT=4). Compare the arms with each other (heuristic against base-no-table: does the library's own choice beat hipBLASEx; heuristic against table: can the per-version table go); the plain config is only the drift control. Lossy: the heuristic and a table can pick another kernel than hipBLASEx, so the text may differ in the last bits (text identity against base is information; the quality gate decides, not this spec). Prompt cases only (prompt tok/s). Driven by hand or by tools/pancake/box_chains/bench-hipblaslt-arms.sh (fills @CONFIG_PLAIN@, @UPDATED@, @UPDATED_SRC@ as bench-updatedRD.sh does).
